This pathogen cannot supply K. pneumoniae targets.

findings.reason: MI001 remains AMBIGUOUS and OPEN, needed_at prepare. This panel supports a local association among Figure 3d, P. aeruginosa FADDI-PA102, PMB MIC, regimen and terminal responses (A72, A74–A75). A76 explicitly states that no matched measured PK is available for these efficacy regimens. This does not resolve the panel–regimen–strain–MIC–response and exposure verification required by DR020 and SC032, or establish links to separate panels.
findings.needed_material: At prepare, document the supported local associations and obtain source-supported PK or exposure links and compatibility evidence before accepting matched regimen-level exposure-response records. Record the required MI001 outcome; retain it OPEN until resolved or otherwise handled by the applicable gate. Independent PK work remains separately assessable.

findings.reason: The panel supplies organism/strain, lung-burden units, individual terminal responses, baseline and vehicle observations, MIC value, regimen and observation times. Inoculum, host immune status, infection-to-treatment interval, explicit treatment duration, MIC method, medium, standard, replicates and summary definition are NOT_FOUND on this page. The observation time alone does not establish all treatment-history details. Separate-PK compatibility is unassessed, and this single-regimen panel does not establish frequency variation for index ranking.
findings.needed_material: Obtain source-supported infection-model context, complete treatment history, matched-MIC measurement context and exposure compatibility. Assess frequency/interval variation across verified records before index ranking. Keep unsupported fields UNRESOLVED without fitting or selecting an index at this stage.

findings.reason: No values are supplied for E80, F78 or F80. The source gives no missingness explanation or censoring definition for these positions. Mouse-number headers cannot establish complete group sizes or repeated animal identity, particularly because A75 states that each mouse contributes one terminal point.
findings.needed_material: Preserve the absent entries as missing with unspecified reasons; confirm their interpretation during preparation. Keep mouse identifiers scoped to their treatment arms and retain note-derived values separately for confirmation.

findings.reason: A72 identifies P. aeruginosa FADDI-PA102. These PMB efficacy observations are relevant source material for independent scope review, but R14 prohibits other pathogens from setting K. pneumoniae targets.
findings.needed_material: Independently review the permitted supporting or benchmark role of this panel. Preserve its pathogen identity and exclude it from K. pneumoniae target estimation.
